title: Traversal-bounded provenance
durable_memory: A provenance conclusion is only as strong as the retained repository-traversal envelope that supports it. Search visibility, authenticated access, and multiple agreeing query methods do not by themselves establish complete reachable-history coverage.

claims.claim: M-004, M-005, and M-006 remain unresolved because no retained exhaustive ref inventory, reachable-commit traversal, deleted-path inspection, and origin assignment source currently closes the provenance gap.

Repository search results and branch-search results are discovery evidence, not coverage evidence, unless their pagination, permission scope, and reachable graph are independently retained and reconciled.

Every terminal provenance outcome should cite a schema-valid repository traversal envelope whose ref inventory is complete, permission scope is known, unvisited reachable commit count is zero, deleted paths were inspected, and blind-spot lists are empty.
Agreement among authenticated code search, commit search, and branch search is sufficient to classify a missing identifier as historically absent.
claims.superseded_by: Coverage must be demonstrated through retained graph traversal rather than inferred from search agreement.

claims.claim: Whether an exhaustive accessible-history traversal will locate immutable origins for M-004, M-005, and M-006 or support an exhaustive-unlocated outcome.

falsification_routes: Produce a retained traversal envelope showing complete accessible history and an immutable object that assigns one of the identifiers to its claimed artifact.
Produce two immutable candidates satisfying the identity agreement rule, which would change the outcome to conflicting_candidates.
Demonstrate a permission, pagination, ref, commit-graph, historical-path, or deleted-path blind spot, which keeps terminal provenance prohibited.
privacy_boundary: Repository metadata, abstract provenance semantics, and public-safe identifiers only. No private chat text, credentials, personal records, or unreviewed File Library content retained.
